name: io.github.giliandar5-lab/agon
title: Agon
description: Shared chat and task board where Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Antigravity agents build one project

packageArguments.description: This agent's name in the team: claude (Claude Code), gpt (Codex) or gemini (Antigravity)

environmentVariables.name: AGON_DB
environmentVariables.description: The team's database file; every agent of one team uses the same one (default ~/.agon/agon.db)

environmentVariables.name: AGON_TEST_CMD
environmentVariables.description: The command that runs your project's tests, which Agon runs before a review, such as python -m pytest -q
